notes: 6.8: custom target languages are back — add one from Settings by entering its code (e.g. yue) and it appears in every language menu on both frontends, no restart; restoring it also fixed a code/filename case mismatch that raised FileNotFoundError mid-translation on Linux, and a custom language silently translating to English in real-time voice. Includes the 6.7.1 fix (which this supersedes): Word no longer sends embedded-image base64 from a drawing's alt-text attribute to the model — one real document wasted ~515k tokens on it. / 6.8：自定义语言回来了——在设置里填语言代号（如 yue）即可添加，两端语言下拉立即可选，无需重启；同时修好了提示词文件名与语言代号大小写不一致（Linux 上翻译时报错）以及实时语音选自定义语言会静默翻成英语的问题。本版包含并取代 6.7.1 的修复：Word 不再把图片替代文字属性里的 base64 当正文翻译（实测一份文档白烧约 51.5 万 tokens）。
